title: Symplectic Stafford: Lean 4 formalization checkpoint
description: Lean 4 formalization checkpoint for the symplectic Stafford same-divisor programme. The repository proves original-ring semantic and support-boundary interfaces, explicit opposite transport, ordered common-colon identities, raw filtered/Rees term coherence, finite right-denominator clearing, finite division-coordinate pencil avoidance, conditional finite-index P_h composition, and the terminal zero-quotient/cofactor boundary, with a Mathlib-only Challenge/Solution pair. It does not claim the universal higher-dimensional source-selection or same-divisor theorem; Phase I and Phase II release gates remain explicit.
notes: A Zenodo DOI is intentionally absent until an authorized GitHub release is archived and Zenodo issues the identifiers. Machine checks and human mathematical review are separate gates.
